problema.pergunta: What problem do you solve for your customer?
problema.ajuda: Every business starts from someone's annoyance. With a clear problem, it is easy to explain why someone would pay.
problema.exemplo: the neighbourhood only has chain burgers, pricey and slow to deliver.

paraQuem.ajuda: The clearer your customer, the easier it is to decide price, place and promotion. Start with the first group who would buy.
paraQuem.exemplo: families and people working from home, within 3 km.

diferencial.pergunta: Why would someone choose you over someone else?
diferencial.ajuda: It is your promise in one sentence. It comes back in the rest of the plan and in the document.
diferencial.exemplo: handmade burgers that arrive hot in 25 minutes.

solucao.pergunta: How do you solve that problem?
solucao.ajuda: Say what you sell and how you deliver it. Start simple: you can improve it later.
solucao.exemplo: short menu, orders by WhatsApp and our own delivery.

canais.pergunta: How do customers hear about you and buy?
canais.ajuda: Instagram, WhatsApp, word of mouth, a shop, an app… Without a path to the customer, there is no sale.
canais.exemplo: local Instagram, the building's group chat and WhatsApp for orders.

receitas.pergunta: How does money come into your business?
receitas.ajuda: What you charge, how much and how. Think about how much each customer spends per purchase.
receitas.exemplo: burgers and combos; average ticket of $ 32.

custos.ajuda: List the biggest: rent, supplies, wages, fees. They go into the break-even calculation.
custos.exemplo: kitchen rent, ingredients, gas, delivery rider.

metricas.bloco: How to tell it is working
metricas.pergunta: Which numbers show the business is doing well?
metricas.ajuda: Pick 1 or 2 numbers to check every week. Without them, it is hard to know whether something needs to change.
metricas.exemplo: burgers sold per month, customers who come back within 30 days.

vantagem.pergunta: What do you have that a competitor can't copy quickly?
vantagem.ajuda: A recipe, a location, a contact or the neighbours' trust. If you don't have one yet, that's fine: leave it blank.
vantagem.exemplo: our own sauce recipe and the relationship with the neighbours.

segmentos.pergunta: Which groups of customers do you sell to?
segmentos.ajuda: It can be more than one group. If the person who pays and the one who uses are different, list both.
segmentos.exemplo: local families and small companies ordering for meetings.

proposta.pergunta: What does each group gain by choosing you?
proposta.ajuda: Time, price, quality, convenience… It is the reason customers come back.
proposta.exemplo: handmade burgers, hot in 25 minutes, no minimum order.

canais.pergunta: How do you reach customers and deliver what you sell?
canais.ajuda: How they find you, buy and receive. Each step can have a different channel.
canais.exemplo: Instagram to promote, WhatsApp to order, our own rider to deliver.

relacionamento.pergunta: How do you look after customers so they come back?
relacionamento.ajuda: Service, loyalty, after-sales. A returning customer costs less than a new one.
relacionamento.exemplo: loyalty card: the 10th burger is on the house.

receitas.pergunta: Where does each dollar coming in come from?
receitas.ajuda: List the ways you charge: single sale, combo, order, delivery fee.
receitas.exemplo: single burgers, family combos and the delivery fee.

recursos.pergunta: What do you need to have in order to work?
recursos.ajuda: Equipment, place, people and know-how. Think of what would be missed if it disappeared tomorrow.
recursos.exemplo: griddle, freezer, delivery bike and the sauce recipe.

atividades.pergunta: What do you need to do every week for the business to run?
atividades.ajuda: The tasks that, if they stop, stop the business. Helps you see how much time and how many people you need.
atividades.exemplo: local burger place — buy supplies, make the burgers, deliver, post on Instagram.

parcerias.pergunta: Who, outside the business, can help you?
parcerias.ajuda: Suppliers, partners and people who refer you. Good partners lower costs or bring customers.
parcerias.exemplo: the bakery that delivers the buns, the local butcher, the building manager next door.

custos.pergunta: How much does it cost to keep the business running?
custos.ajuda: Separate what is fixed (paid every month) from what changes with sales. It is the same split as in the break-even calculator.
custos.exemplo: fixed: rent and internet; variable: beef, buns and packaging.

quem.pergunta: Give your ideal customer a name and an age
quem.ajuda: Picturing a real person helps you make decisions. It can be made up.

rotina.pergunta: Where does this person live and what is their day like?
rotina.ajuda: Neighbourhood, work, family, schedule. Whatever helps you understand when and how they buy.
rotina.exemplo: lives near the shop, works from home, has two young kids.

quer.pergunta: What do they want to solve when they look for a business like yours?
quer.ajuda: It is not the product itself: it is the result they expect.
quer.exemplo: a tasty dinner without cooking at the end of the day.

incomoda.pergunta: What annoys this person most about the options they have today?
incomoda.exemplo: late deliveries and burgers that arrive cold.

decide.pergunta: How do they choose who to buy from?
decide.ajuda: Price, referrals, reviews, distance… What matters most to them?
decide.exemplo: neighbours' recommendations and the building's group chat.

proposta.pergunta: In one sentence: why would they choose you?
proposta.ajuda: Combine what they want with what you do differently. This sentence is highlighted in the document.
proposta.exemplo: handmade burgers that arrive hot in 25 minutes, without the wait of the big chains.

swot.dica: Tip: 2 to 4 short items are enough.
swot.revisaoToque: Tap a part to adjust it.
swot.revisaoNota: In the document, this becomes the 2×2 matrix of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats.

forcas.pergunta: What is your business already good at?
forcas.ajuda: Think of what customers praise or what you do better than others.
forcas.exemplo: our own sauce recipe, fast delivery, knows customers by name.

fraquezas.pergunta: What is still missing or holding your business back?
fraquezas.ajuda: No guilt: it is what you can improve. Lack of people, money, time.
fraquezas.placeholder: E.g. only one person in the kitchen
fraquezas.exemplo: only one person in the kitchen, little money saved, no social media.

oportunidades.pergunta: What is happening out there that could help you?
oportunidades.ajuda: Changes in the neighbourhood, in people's habits or in the market.
oportunidades.exemplo: more people working from home, new buildings, street fairs.

ameacas.pergunta: What, out there, could get in the way of your plans?
ameacas.ajuda: Things you don't control but need to keep an eye on.
ameacas.exemplo: beef prices going up, big chains on promotion, delivery app fees.
